text:
Customer: I got an email saying my flight was cancelled and offering a credit voucher. I don't want a voucher, I want a refund to my card.
Agent: I understand. Can I have your booking reference?
Customer: Mm, Z, X, four, one, eight, B.
Agent: Okay, Mr. Dawson. The flight from Manchester to Dublin on the twelfth was cancelled by us. You're entitled to a full refund if you choose not to travel. The voucher is optional.
Customer: Good. How long does it take?
Agent: Up to seven days for card payments, sometimes faster. I'll process it now. Do you want the refund for the return portion as well?
Customer: Yes, I'm not going at all.
Agent: Then I'll refund the whole booking, three hundred and twelve pounds. You'll get a confirmation email.
Customer: And what about the hotel I booked? That's nonrefundable.
Agent: I'm afraid hotel costs are handled separately. You can submit receipts, and we'll review them under our compensation policy.

metadata.note: Refund request for a cancelled flight with voucher offer
